card.name: Z inside brand and drug names
card.fires_on: The letter Z (or YZ, inz) in the middle of a name, such as a brand drug name or a person's name. Examples are RYZNEUTA, ZURZUVAE, Dorzolamide, Brinzolamide and Curzio.

modes.label: Brand names
modes.description: The Z or YZ piece inside an invented capitalized brand name.

modes.label: Generic drug names
modes.description: A z-containing piece inside a generic name ending in -olamide.

modes.label: Personal names
modes.description: A z piece inside a foreign personal name in general text.

card.plain: It lights up on the Z sound partway through unusual drug brand names and other rare names.
